[[0, 8, 0, 6, 0]]
def transform(grid):
    def compress(n, marked):
        out=[]
        start=0
        for x in sorted(marked):
            if start < x: out.append(start)
            out.append(x)
            start=x+1
        if start < n: out.append(start)
        return out
    rows=len(grid); cols=len(grid[0])
    # Colored full rows and columns are the separators.
    row_marks=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    col_marks=[c for c in range(cols) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=0]
    ri=compress(rows,row_marks); ci=compress(cols,col_marks)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in ci] for r in ri]
